title: Feeding 4,000 People in Topkapi Palace
hook: The palace employed 1,000 cooks organized by dessert specialties.

scenes.text: Inside Istanbul's Topkapi Palace, the imperial kitchens formed an enormous complex of ten soaring domed culinary factories.
scenes.imagePrompt: Row of ten historic brick conical chimneys and domes of the Topkapi Palace kitchens overlooking the Sea of Marmara. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Inside Istanbul's Topkapi Palace, the imperial kitchens formed an enormous complex of ten soaring domed culinary factories.

scenes.text: A workforce of over one thousand chefs and kitchen apprentices worked daily to feed four thousand imperial residents every single day.
scenes.imagePrompt: Vast kitchen hall with whitewashed brick walls, massive wood-burning stone hearths, and rows of heavy butcher prep tables. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: A workforce of over one thousand chefs and kitchen apprentices worked daily to feed four thousand imperial residents every single day.

scenes.text: Kitchens were strictly divided by guild: one building made only baklava, another prepared spit-roasted lamb, and another specialized in fruit sherbets.
scenes.imagePrompt: Large round copper pastry trays piled with golden flaky baklava layers soaked in honey syrup and ground green pistachios. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Kitchens were strictly divided by guild: one building made only baklava, another prepared spit-roasted lamb, and another specialized in fruit sherbets.

scenes.text: The Sultan's private food was prepared under extreme security: official food tasters sampled every dish to test for assassination poisons.
scenes.imagePrompt: Imperial dining table with fine Chinese celadon green porcelain bowls, gold covered dishes, and jeweled serving spoons. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: The Sultan's private food was prepared under extreme security: official food tasters sampled every dish to test for assassination poisons.

scenes.text: They believed celadon porcelain bowls possessed magical properties that changed color or shattered if touched by lethal poisons.
